blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas’ Khy Progella and Sofiah Pagara completed a historic bronze medal run in the Asian Games 2026 women’s beach volleyball event. A day after their semifinal heartbreak, Progella and Pagara eked out a come-from-behind 13-21, 23-21, 15-13 win over China’s Cao Shuting and Dong Jie to secure the podium finish on Thursday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court. The young duo never wavered despite getting dominated in the opening set and the Chinese taking the match point, 20-19, in the second, digging deep to force a […]...
